claim_being_audited: Whether the current release can be certified as model-card compliant on the basis of current aggregate readiness and rehearsal results, despite a documented subgroup regression, because the packet will rely on current-result disclosure rather than prior approval or informal monitoring.
decision_criteria: Current release documentation must reflect current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses must be disclosed in the release documentation or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context only and cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
A compliant certification requires evidence that these predicates are already satisfied for the current release, not merely that they could be satisfied by updating the packet.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or certification packet showing current evaluation results and the exact disclosure of the health-plan benefits subgroup limitation.
Provide the underlying current evaluation report for the named release, including aggregate readiness and subgroup slice results.
Provide any approved mitigation, risk acceptance, or reviewer signoff tied specifically to this release and this subgroup regression.
Provide the launch-use-case documentation showing the disclosed limitation is attached to the actual release decision record.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or include an approved mitigation, but no actual current model-card text or approved mitigation is in admissible evidence.

The actor's conclusion depends on a future-state condition: certification is said to be most defensible if the packet brings the model card current and explicitly discloses the subgroup limitation. That does not show the condition is already satisfied.

A documented subgroup regression below the warning threshold is described as a material weakness, but no admissible evidence shows formal materiality handling, reviewer signoff, or risk acceptance for this release.
Prior approval and informal monitoring are expressly inadequate under the policy, so they cannot close the support gap.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant, rather than only potentially supportable if current documentation is updated and disclosure is added.
That the audit packet itself already brings the model card current and expressly discloses the subgroup limitation.
That informal monitoring and ongoing measurement are sufficient governance controls absent reviewed mitigation or approved risk acceptance.
